question: A pair of complex numbers \(z_1,z_2\) is said to have property \(P\) if for every complex number \(z\), we can find real numbers \(r\) and \(s\) such that \(z=rz_1+sz_2\). Show that a pair \(z_1,z_2\) has property \(P\) if and only if the points \(z_1,z_2\) and \(0\) on the complex plane are not collinear.
